baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence kafaru wa-kadhdhabu bi-ayatina is followed by the deictic ulaika and the relational predicate ashab al-jahim.
baseline_models.mechanism: A marker that is available to recognition is first covered and then actively assigned to falsehood. The double response is answered not merely by placement near fire but by a defining companionship with concentrated blaze.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering supplies an active occlusion operation and makes kufr more than missing information.
Attributing falsehood supplies the explicit verdict imposed on what the first operation has covered.
The visible marker supplies the available evidence against which covering and falsification operate.
Companionship and close persistence turn the consequence from incidental contact into a defining relation.
Intensely kindled heat supplies the material state to which the subjects become durably related.

changed_reading.before: A generic statement that unbelievers who deny signs will be in hell.
changed_reading.after: A causal verdict: visible markers are actively occluded and classified as false, and that practiced relation hardens into companionship with an intense blaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier scene carries kufr into an encounter and back out of it while something is concealed inside. This strengthens the covering image into a portable interior condition whose public face in 5:86 is active takdhib.

activation_trace.role: Covering anchors the focus reading in an operation that can be carried and maintained.
Interior and hidden disposition locates the covering beneath the public encounter.
The same covering branch is explicitly carried at entry and therefore supplies continuity with the focus verb.
Concealment and covering expose the hidden operation that the focus pair later renders as an overt verdict.

structural_cues: 5:61 brackets k-f-r with entry and exit and closes with yaktumun.
5:86 coordinates kafaru with the outward act kadhdhabu.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies entry, exit, kufr, and concealment; I infer that a covered interior is carried through the encounter and then expressed as takdhib; alternatively 5:61 may describe performative hypocrisy without defining every instance of 5:86.

changed_reading.before: Kafaru names an isolated doctrinal stance.
changed_reading.after: Kafaru can name a maintained inner cover that survives entry and exit, while kadhdhabu is the outward act that enforces that cover against the signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated choices of wilaya establish a social grammar of nearness, support, and governing attachment. The final ashab construction converts that chosen affiliation into terminal belonging: the blaze is the companion-relation that remains.

activation_trace.role: Close companionship supplies the terminal relational category rather than a merely spatial label.
The blaze becomes the object and environment of the final companionship.
Love, support, and alliance supply the first explicit choice of companion-relation in the window.
Actualized alliance shows the prohibited relation becoming a repeated social practice.
The allied group is identified by obstruction of truth, tying the social practice directly to the focus class.
The counterfactual says belief would interrupt this alliance, making affiliation diagnostic rather than incidental.

structural_cues: 5:57 prohibits taking the mockers and disbelievers as awliya, 5:80 observes that alliance, and 5:81 makes it incompatible with belief.
5:86 closes with the relational noun ashab rather than a bare locative expression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated alliance choices and a final companionship predicate; I infer a trajectory from chosen nearness to terminal belonging; alternatively wilaya and ashab may be parallel social and eschatological labels without a causal bridge.

changed_reading.before: Ashab al-jahim means only people assigned to a destination.
changed_reading.after: Ashab al-jahim is the terminal form of an affiliation pattern: practiced attachments culminate in an inseparable companionship with the blaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: Every attempted ignition of war-fire is cooled and extinguished, yet the work of corruption continues. The focus then names a fully blazing war-like heat as their enduring companion, producing an ironic reversal from fires they try to control to a blaze that defines and contains them.

activation_trace.role: War and mortal conflagration make al-jahim the focus anchor for the earlier fire-of-war field.
Persistent companionship reverses agency: the former kindlers are now defined by the fire they accompany.
Active ignition supplies the recurring human production of combustion.
Kindled fire supplies the concrete material object whose transformed return is the focus blaze.
War and enmity identify the combustion as a social practice and connect it to the war branch of jahim.
Cooling flame and embers supplies the first reversal: their recurrent fires do not remain under their command.
Departure from sound order explains why the destructive mechanism continues after each quenching.

structural_cues: 5:64 uses kullama to make ignition and extinction recurrent.
The earlier fire is explicitly for war, while the focus jahim inventory contains a war-and-death conflagration branch.
5:86 stands at the window's close and turns fire from their instrument into their companionship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent war-fire, divine extinction, continuing corruption, and final companionship with a blaze; I infer an ironic return or measure-correspondence from kindling to being contained by fire; alternatively the mundane war-fire and eschatological jahim may remain separate scenes.

changed_reading.before: Al-jahim is an unrelated future fire appended to denial.
changed_reading.after: Al-jahim can be the transformed return of a recurrent war-making practice: fires they kindle are quenched, but an uncontrollable blaze becomes their lasting companion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated messengers are assigned to falsehood, sight and hearing close twice, and signs are nevertheless explicitly made clear. The focus pair therefore reads as a constructed non-recognition process: occlude the available marker, close reception, then pronounce the marker false.

activation_trace.role: Covering anchors the first operation in a process that suppresses access to what is shown.
Assigning falsehood anchors the second operation as an active judgment, not passive uncertainty.
A manifest marker is the object whose recognizability the process defeats.
Repeated attribution of falsehood to arriving messengers supplies the historical recurrence of the focus act.
Blindness of insight, repeated on both sides of a restoration, supplies deliberate perceptual closure.
Loss of hearing and refusal to attend close a second reception channel in the same repeated pattern.
Disclosure through speech or sign establishes that the evidence is being clarified rather than withheld.
The same manifest-marker branch makes the clarified objects continuous with ayatina in the focus.
Turning a thing away from its proper direction supplies the final deflection after clarification.

structural_cues: 5:70 uses kullama for recurring messenger-arrival and recurring takdhib.
5:71 repeats blindness and deafness around a divine return.
5:75 doubles unzur around the clarification of signs and the subsequent turning-away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent takdhib, repeated sensory closure, clarified signs, and subsequent deflection; I infer a sequence in which covering enables the falsehood verdict; alternatively the passive turning in 5:75 may emphasize an imposed diversion rather than self-produced closure.

changed_reading.before: The subjects deny because the signs fail to become evident to them.
changed_reading.after: Their non-recognition is repeatedly constructed after evidence arrives: channels close, manifest markers are deflected, and takdhib formalizes the resulting cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final sequence presents two response trajectories to disclosed truth. Hearing becomes understanding, recognition fills and overflows through tears and testimony, requested entry is answered by flowing and abiding reward; covering and falsifying the same kind of marker instead contract into durable companionship with heat.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the closed-response operation on the negative limb of the fork.
The manifest marker anchors both trajectories in a response to recognizable evidence.
Persistent companionship supplies the negative trajectory's settled relational outcome.
Concentrated heat supplies the material opposite of the preceding sequence's easy flow.
Explicit permanence on the punishment side sharpens companionship in the focus as an enduring state.
Hearing as understanding and compliance opens the positive reception trajectory.
Easy abundant flow converts inward reception into an outward bodily response.
A vessel filled until it overflows supplies the pressure mechanism linking recognition to tears.
Recognition through a trace or marker provides the positive counterpart to covering ayat.
Stable correspondence with reality identifies what recognition successfully receives.
Knowledge-bearing declaration turns reception into public testimony, opposite the public verdict of takdhib.
Entry supplies the requested spatial transition produced by receptive recognition.
Unimpeded running flow materializes the positive trajectory as sustained movement.
Opening and widening until flow occurs supplies a spatial opposite to epistemic closure.
Adhesion and abiding make the positive outcome durable and sharpen the parallel durability of ashab.

structural_cues: 5:83-86 is consecutive: hearing, recognition, overflow, confession, requested entry, reward, then wa-alladhina introduces the contrary group.
5:85 and 5:86 both close their group portraits with a deictic classification and an enduring environment.
Permanence appears on both the punishment side in 5:80 and the garden side in 5:85.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered receptive sequence, entry, flowing reward, permanence, and then the contrary focus response; I infer that the signs function as a common input whose reception or occlusion generates opposite trajectories; alternatively these may be juxtaposed portraits rather than a formal process model.

changed_reading.before: 5:86 is an isolated condemnation appended after a reward verse.
changed_reading.after: 5:86 is the closed limb of a two-output response system: recognition opens into overflow, testimony, entry, and sustained flow, while covering and falsification contract into enduring thermal companionship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The echo is surprising because it links distinct roots through a shared material image of covering. It remains anchored in the focus k-f-r branch and the immediately preceding garden branch, but downstream prose should present it only as an adjacent branch-image contrast, not as lexical identity or the verse's controlling sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Kafaru in 5:86 directly supports the covering image; immediately before it, jannat supports a tree-covered garden image, while jahim supplies destructive heat.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the destructive epistemic operation whose object is a manifest sign.
Blazing heat supplies the barren outcome opposed to a sheltering and fertile cover.
A garden covered by trees supplies a life-bearing form of cover immediately before the focus.
Returning consequence makes the two unlike coverings readable as divergent outcomes rather than a claim that covering itself is uniformly negative.
Beautiful action locates the fertile cover on the receptive side of the contrast.

changed_reading.before: The material image of covering in kufr is intrinsically and uniformly negative.
changed_reading.after: The adjacency permits a contained contrast between two coverings: receptive action returns as fertile shelter, while covering manifest signs returns as unsheltered companionship with heat.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the dominant jahim image is fire, not an eye. It remains valid as a secondary optic echo because the focus inventory itself includes a glaring or inflamed eye and the packet repeatedly stages blindness versus eyes overflowing upon recognition. Downstream prose should qualify it as an exploratory resonance and retain literal blaze as primary.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-jahim in 5:86 carries an inventory branch of a kindled or bulging eye, allowing the focus blaze to echo the packet's contrasting eye responses.

activation_trace.role: The inflamed, fixed, or bulging eye supplies the direct focus anchor for an optic rendering of jahim.
Repeated loss of sight supplies the closed-eye pole of the packet's perceptual contrast.
The seeing eye supplies the organ that responds differently when truth is recognized.
Abundant easy flow makes the receptive eye release rather than remain fixed or inflamed.
Tears and their channel give the receptive eye a concrete outward passage.
Recognition through a marker explains why these eyes flow and distinguishes them from blocked sight.

changed_reading.before: Jahim contributes only an external furnace image.
changed_reading.after: Secondarily and exploratorily, jahim may also mirror failed seeing as a fixed, inflamed gaze, set against eyes that recognize and open into tears.

strongest_changes: The recurrent war-fire of 5:64 makes al-jahim an ironic return: attempted fires are extinguished, yet their kindlers end in companionship with the blaze.
Repeated wilaya turns ashab al-jahim from a bare destination label into the terminal form of practiced affiliation.
The 5:83-86 sequence forms a response fork: recognition opens into tears, testimony, entry, flow, and abiding, while covering and falsifying signs contract into durable heat.
summary.what_was_special: Relational, perceptual, and material mechanisms converged without collapsing: ally became companion, clarified marker met covering, open recognition became flow, and recurrent ignition returned as blaze. The packet also exposed contained secondary echoes between fertile and destructive covering and between flowing and inflamed eyes.
remaining_uncertainties: The war-fire return may be a designed thematic reversal or only a strong branch-supported analogy.
The durability of ashab is sharpened by nearby kh-l-d language, but the amount carried by ashab alone remains uncertain.
The garden-cover and ocular-jahim outliers are deliberately branch-distant and should remain subordinate to the stronger relational and fire readings.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The repeated formula now reverses visible recognition.** `ك ف ر B001` is concealment, `ء ي ي B003` visible sign, and `ص ح ب B001` close association. After tears made recognition visible in 5:83, this ayah's concealment reads as chosen suppression of a comparable sign-response; the result is fixed companionship with exposure (`ج ح م B003`, staring glow).
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Denial chooses a different company.** Fixed **ص ح ب / B001** (“companionship and close association”) makes *aṣḥāb* answer the repeated “with the witnesses” and “with the sound people” of 5:83–5:84. The preceding positive sequence culminates in garden residence; 5:87–5:90 then distinguish permitted goods from tainting consumption. I infer that response to signs incorporates agents into a durable environment. The compact contrast reads as relational sorting into company, not merely juxtaposed reward labels.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:90–5:91 made the companionship model behavioral by showing how chosen intake embeds users in veiling, entanglement, hostility, and ritual obstruction.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه أي في الاستفهام والجزاء والصلة والنعت والتعجب وحكاية النكرات، وما يتصل بها من أيهم وأيما وأية.
يدخل فيه إيا مع الكاف والهاء والياء في موضع الاسم المنصوب، كإياك، وذكرها عمادا للضمير في التحذير وغيره.
يدخل فيه أيان إذا جعلت بمنزلة متى للسؤال عن الزمان، مع الخلاف في نونها أهي أصلية أم زائدة.
يدخل فيه كأين أو كائن في معنى كم، مع الكاف الزائدة والنون التي تشبه التنوين أو تكون مع أي أصلا.
يدخل فيه أي في نداء القريب، وأيا في نداء القريب والبعيد، وآي الممدودة في النداء.
يدخل فيه أي التي تتقدم تفسير المعنى، كقولهم أي كذا وكذا أو أي بمعنى تريد كذا.
يدخل فيه إي المكسورة التي تدخل في اليمين أو تتقدم القسم بمعنى نعم أو بلى.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin başka bir şeyle yakın ve süreğen biçimde birlikte bulunmasını çekirdek anlam olarak verir. Kişi, hayvan, yer ve zamanla kurulan eşlik ilişkisi bu çekirdeğe girerken sahiplik, bir işin başında bulunma ve yanında bir eşlikçi bulunması belirli yapılara bağlı uzantılardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şeyle geçici olmayan biçimde birlikte bulunmak, ona eşlik etmek veya onunla yakınlığını sürdürmektir. Belirli yapılarda bir şeyin sahibi ya da sorumlusu olmayı ve kişinin yanında bir eşlikçi bulunmasını da anlatır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, iki tarafın yakın ve süreğen biçimde birlikte bulunması ya da birinin ötekine eşlik etmesidir.
Eşlik eden taraf kişi, hayvan, yer veya zamanla ilişkili olabilir; tekil eşlikçi ve eşlikçiler topluluğu da adlandırılabilir.
Belirli ad tamlamalarında bir şeyin sahibi, ona bağlı kişi veya onun işini yürüten sorumlu kastedilir.
Bir kişinin yanında kendisine eşlik eden birinin bulunması da bu anlam alanının yapıya bağlı uzantısıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, sıradan bir araya gelmeden daha güçlü olan yakın ve sürekli eşliktir; kişi adları, topluluk adları, sahiplik ve sorumluluk kullanımları bu çekirdeğin çevresinde yer alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: En yakın ağır savaş dalı ile savaşın alevlendirilmesi ve öldürme alanı ayrıntılı karşılaştırıldı. Yiğitlik, tehlikeye atılma, öldürücü vuruş, genel savaş adı ve ağır savaş kalıpları aynı olay alanında kalsalar da çekirdeğin yerine geçmez.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الموت جاحم (maqayis;sihah)؛ جاحم الحرب شدة القتل في معركتها (ayn;tahdhib)؛ الحرب لا يبقى لجاحمها التخيل والمراح (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü tek bir dışa çıkık veya ateşli göz biçimini değil, bazı yerel kullanımlarda gözün adını, aslanın gözlerini, gözleri dikerek açmayı, keskin bakışı, iri kızıl göz niteliğini ve bir göz hastalığını birlikte verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici göz görüntüsü bu farklı yönlerin yalnız bir bölümünü temsil eder.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yerel göz adını ve gözle kurulan yapılara bağlı eylem, nitelik ve hastalık anlamlarını ayırır; tek bir yalın göz biçimine indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Bazı yerel kullanımlarda gözün adını ve özellikle aslanın gözlerini; gözleri dikerek açma veya keskin bakma eylemini; iri ve koyu kızıl göz niteliğini; ayrıca gözleri şişiren bir hastalığı kapsar.

facets.statement: Sözcük bazı yerel kullanımlarda doğrudan gözün adı olarak kullanılır.
Aslanın iki gözü, parıldayan veya ateşli görünüşleriyle özel olarak adlandırılır.
Gözleri bir noktaya dikerek açma ve birine keskin bakma eylemleri anlatılır.
Gözün iri ve koyu kızıl olması kişiyi niteleyen belirgin bir görünüş özelliğidir.
İnsanın gözlerini şişiren bilinen bir göz hastalığının adı da bu dalda yer alır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar göz adında ve aslanın gözlerinde birleşir; öteki veriler aynı alanı gözleri dikme, keskin bakış, iri kızıl göz niteliği ve göz şişiren hastalık yönleriyle genişletir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجحمة بمعنى العين، وجحمتا الأسد، وفتح العينين كالشاخص، وحد النظر، وحمرة العين مع سعتها، وداء الجحام في العين.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الجحمة العين بلغة اليمن وجحمتا الأسد عيناه وجحم الرجل إذا فتح عينيه كالشاخص والعين جاحمة والجحام داء يصيب الإنسان في عينيه والأجحم الشديد حمرة العين مع سعتها (maqayis)؛ الجحمة العين بلغة حمير وجحمتا الأسد عيناه بكل لغة والأجحم الشديد حمرة العين مع سعتها (ayn)؛ جحم الرجل فتح عينيه كالشاخص وجحمني بعينيه تجحيما أحد إلي النظر والجحام داء يصيب الانسان فترم عيناه (sihah)؛ الجحمة هي العين بلغة حمير وجحمتا الأسد عيناه بكل لغة والأجحم الشديد حمرة العين مع سعتها والجحام داء معروف (tahdhib)؛ جحمتا الأسد عيناه لتوقدهما (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه جحم وجهه من شدة الغضب على جهة الاستعارة من جحمة النار وثوران حرارة القلب.
